Description.SourceString: A five-headed dragon and a hidden island took spot #1 and #2 respectively, but the presence of dragon metal was the third most surprising thing that Zilyana found on Ashenfall. Dragon metal meant a sequence of things to the icyene. It meant that the dragonkin had not only lived here, but lived here long enough to create their own dragons and combine their dragonfire with orikalkum. She noted it as something that she wanted to investigate further - once the malevolent dragon-queen was stopped, of course.
